'''Lord Niach''' of House Okatomo was the commander of [[Rena Tower]] at the southern edge of the [[Blight]] in northern [[Kandor]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Niach Okatomo}}

==Trivia==
*Niach Okatomo is named for Nick Okamoto, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
